name: The Rusty Lantern
opening: Rain hammers against the shuttered windows of The Rusty Lantern. Inside, a peat fire crackles weakly in the hearth, casting long shadows across rough-hewn tables. Behind the scarred oak bar, a one-eyed innkeeper polishes a mug with a gray rag while a hooded figure in the far corner watches the door. An empty wooden bucket sits beside the hearth.
